completion_gate: Both exact review-only artifacts exist and bind all relied-upon inputs.
The contract either supplies every schedule, schema, probability, rank, resource, control, and verification field or identifies the first missing obligation in a scoped no-go derivation.
Exactly one recommended next action is recorded and no implementation or experiment is authorized.
constraints: Review-only theory and schema work; do not implement or execute any experiment.
Use public documentation and toy/public fixture descriptions only.
Seal a hash-bound pre-execution attempt schedule, seeds, retry graph, terminal vocabulary, field, canonical row format, and column schema.
Define an exact schedule-to-terminal-receipt bijection and independent relation, row, and incremental-rank verification.
Preserve CPU, wall time, group operations, I/O, communication, retained bytes, and peak memory as a resource vector with explicit ownership and no illicit scalar sum.
Replace ceil(r/p_L) with a declared-alpha binomial or negative-binomial tail gate and state every IID, stratification, or sequential assumption.
Include planted omission, duplicate-ID, retry-cycle, field/schema mismatch, shared-work attribution, certificate/row mismatch, and wrong-field controls.
Avoid the P1553 R4 operation and make no attack improvement, lower-bound, or cryptographic claim.
If a complete contract cannot be constructed, identify the first exact obligation that fails and provide a reader-checkable scoped no-go derivation; do not assert universal impossibility.
Preserve every pre-existing dirty ideas path and write only within the assigned scope.
